api_base.description: The API base for the Aim guardrail. Default is https://api.aim.security. Also checks if the `AIM_API_BASE` environment variable is set.

api_key.description: The API key for the Aim guardrail. If not provided, the `AIM_API_KEY` environment variable is checked.

inspect_embeddings.description: Send /embeddings `input` to Aim as user messages. Off by default because embedding input is documents being indexed, not a conversation.
